ShortcutsText:
Tab — switch panel
Enter — open · Backspace — up · Alt+← — back
Insert — mark and move down · Ctrl+A — select all
F2 / Shift+F6 — rename
F3 — view (on a folder: folder size)
F4 — edit · Shift+F4 — new file
F5 — copy · F6 — move · F7 — new folder
F8 / Del — Recycle Bin · Shift+Del — delete permanently
Ctrl+C / X / V — clipboard (works with Explorer)
Ctrl+F — search · Ctrl+L — path · Ctrl+R — refresh
Ctrl+H — hidden files · Ctrl+U — swap panels
Ctrl+= — same folder in the other panel
Ctrl+T — terminal · Ctrl+E — Explorer · Alt+Enter — properties
Hold Shift while dragging to move instead of copy
